note: Adapted from Roonwal & Chhotani (1997); the original is in English and does not describe the alate (Imago: Unknown). Type locality: Burma: Maymyo (22.05 N, 96.30 E; alt. 914 m); the description is based on a paratype soldier.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dark brown with a smoky tinge; clypeus, labrum, antennae, legs and abdomen pale brown. Head and body densely covered with minute, thin, almost microscopic hairs, and with a few longer setae. Total length 8.0—10.0 mm. Head large, hypognathous, almost square, the angles weakly rounded; head length to the mandibular base 2.40—2.65 (mean 2.56) mm; maximum width 2.2—2.6 (mean 2.40) mm; height 1.40—1.65 (mean 1.55) mm; width to length ratio 0.93—0.97. Front of the frons gently sloping; Y-shaped suture weak, slightly concave between its arms. No eyes or ocelli. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 the shortest. Labrum small, slightly wider than long (0.3—0.35×0.38—0.45 mm), bluntly ligulate, moderately hairy, rounded at the apex. Postclypeus and anteclypeus narrow transverse bands. Mandibles robust (length 1.40—1.65 mm), broad at the base, abruptly narrowed to a slender point at the apex, the inner margin with a large pointed tooth at the end of the broad basal part. Postmentum short (median length 1.15—1.35 mm, maximum width 0.50—0.55 mm), almost square, raised at the distal 1/4. Pronotum small, less than half as wide as the head, wider than long (0.45—0.60×1.05—1.15 mm), strongly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe much longer than the posterior lobe; anterior margin strongly rounded, posterior margin straight. Mesonotum and metanotum flat, narrow, smaller than the pronotum, lateral margins rounded. Legs long and slender; tibial spurs 2:2:2; tarsi 3-segmented, without an empodium. Abdomen long and rather inflated. Cerci small, 2-segmented; styli absent.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head almost round (head length to the mandibular base 1.01—1.07 mm, maximum width 1.20—1.32 mm), with a pale, almost round mid-dorsal spot (diameter 0.07—0.13 mm). Mandibles with 1 apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth; the second marginal tooth small and, on the left mandible, far from the first. Pronotum wider than long (0.40—0.46×0.66—0.74 mm). Tarsi 3-segmented.
